== Description ==

[[Matt Thornton]] (left, tan Rebel starbird cap, full beard, navy tee, name tag), [[Paul Coggins]] (mid, black “311” cap, plaid shirt), and [[Ken Cross]] (right, glasses, receding hair, grey-black hoodie, yellow card sleeves) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
